title: Open session changes in Intent and retire the Side panel review

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: Caught

Story and revision: SEED-418#select-a-story-session-for-review (plan .planning/slice-plans/876-open-session-changes-in-intent/PLAN.md), revision ba5ff674a99f71304c9a10965fd361efe770f2dc on branch claude/open-session-changes-in-intent-and-retire-the-si.
Promise: With a session chosen, the comparison shows that session's recorded range. When the session recorded several landed runs, they are offered under it, and Source, diff and Proof use the chosen run.
Fault: in dashboard/src/useStoryReviewSelection.ts, the chosen-run read drops `run` for published-session subjects only (`run: selection.run ?? ""` -> `...("published" in subject ? {} : { run: selection.run ?? "" })`). A story's own landed runs are unaffected. No fixtures or assertions were changed.

Setup: scratch `git worktree add --detach` at the revision (removed afterwards), Node 24.21.0, own `npm ci`; checkout clean before the probe; execution checkout untouched.

Runs (E2E strict reporter with OPEN_DOUGH_E2E_PROOF_RECORD under caffeinate -s -i; load average 22–33):
- Baseline: E2E intent-session-scope (2), intent-published-range-source (3), recently-done-published-sessions (2): 7/7 passed, no retries. Frontend intent-story-compare-session-runs: 3/3.
- Faulted: E2E 5 of 7 failed — intent-session-scope "two recorded runs and the shared-checkout warning" at `review.files.expectOnlyChangedFile("Added second-range.txt")`; recently-done-published-sessions "reads the same published ranges with and without this machine's launch" at the same assertion; all 3 intent-published-range-source tests timed out at `review.files.choose("Modified [literal]*.txt")` inside `openSecondPublishedRange` after choosing "Published range 2 of 2". Frontend 2 of 3 failed (range-2 tree; shared-checkout warning).
- Restored: `git diff` empty; E2E 7/7 and frontend 3/3 passed again.

Wrong behavior observed independently: error-context snapshots show the session and "Published range 2 of 2" checked while the summary stays "Reading the story's changes…" with none of range 2's files; the trace holds only `review?...&published=<uuid>` requests and none with `run=2`.

Verdict: Caught, on choosing the second published range of a chosen session. Catching assertions: E2E `IntentReviewFiles.expectOnlyChangedFile("Added second-range.txt")` (intent-session-scope second test; recently-done-published-sessions first test); the `files.choose(changed)` step in intent-published-range-source (helper-level timeout); frontend intent-story-compare-session-runs range-2 tree assertion. The claim covers the run read of a chosen session's ranges, not Proof's use of the chosen range.

Next proof action: none needed for this fault; current proof holds.
Costs: test runtime about 312 s wall clock (baseline E2E 91 s, frontend 18 s; faulted frontend 14 s, E2E 110 s; restored 79 s). Human and agent effort unavailable. Invocation-to-report elapsed 442857 ms (measured).

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision ba5ff674a99f71304c9a10965fd361efe770f2dc; verdict Caught; no follow-up.
